product_overview: Panam Paaru is a personal finance app for tracking income, expenses, and investment holdings in one place. It helps users monitor net worth and review financial trends through dashboards and visual analytics after secure Google sign-in.
core_goals: Sign in securely with Google to access the private finance workspace
Add, review, update, and remove income and expense transactions
Track investment holdings and view portfolio value, invested amount, and returns
Import investment portfolios and manually add holdings
View financial analytics such as spending trends, category distribution, and net worth growth

features.name: Google Authentication
features.description: Users access the app by signing in with Google from a protected landing screen; unauthenticated users cannot enter the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the secure landing screen and product highlights -> Choose to sign in with Google -> Complete Google consent -> See the authenticated dashboard

features.name: Expense and Transaction Tracking
features.description: Users can create and manage income and expense transactions, then filter and maintain their transaction history.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the transaction flow from the dashboard -> Choose income or expense -> Enter amount, title, date, and category -> Save the transaction -> See the new transaction in the list
Navigate to / -> Open the transaction list -> Filter by category or search term -> See the matching transactions
Navigate to / -> Open a transaction from the list -> Edit the transaction details -> Save the changes -> See the updated transaction in the list
Navigate to / -> Open a transaction from the list -> Remove the transaction -> See it disappear from the list

features.name: Investment Portfolio and Net Worth Dashboard
features.description: Users can view their portfolio summary, add holdings manually, search for assets, sync prices, import statements, and review individual investments.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the Investments tab -> View total portfolio value, invested amount, and total returns -> Review allocation breakdown and holdings

Navigate to / -> Open the Investments tab -> Start adding a new investment -> Search for a stock ticker or mutual fund scheme -> Enter the holding details -> Save the investment -> See the holding appear in the portfolio
Navigate to / -> Open the Investments tab -> Start a price sync -> Refresh live market prices -> See updated portfolio values and returns
Navigate to / -> Open the Investments tab -> Start the import flow -> Upload a CAMS or KFintech statement, or an Excel sheet -> Review the imported holdings -> See the portfolio populated with assets

features.name: Analytics and Visualizations
features.description: Users can explore charts and metrics that summarize spending patterns, category mix, savings, and net worth growth.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the Analytics tab -> Select a date range and category filter -> View the updated charts and metrics
Navigate to / -> Open the Analytics tab -> Hover over chart data -> Inspect monthly spending, category distribution, and net worth trends
Navigate to / -> Open the Analytics tab -> Review savings rate and monthly burn rate -> Compare the metrics across the selected period

routes.description: Main application dashboard protected by Google OAuth authentication guard

features.name: Google Authentication
features.description: Protected authentication requiring Google OAuth sign-in. No guest or anonymous access is permitted.
user_interactions: Arrive at unauthenticated screen
View PanamPaaru hero showcase and security highlights
Click "Sign in with Google" button
Complete Google OAuth consent
Automatically redirected to main dashboard shell upon authentication

features.name: Expense and Transaction Tracking
features.description: Create, view, filter, edit, and delete income and expense transactions for authenticated user
user_interactions: Click Add Transaction button
Select Income or Expense
Enter amount, title, date, and category
Click Save Transaction
Filter transactions by category or search term
Click Delete or Edit on transaction card

features.name: Investment Portfolio and Net Worth Dashboard
features.description: Track stocks, mutual funds, gold/SGB, crypto, FDs, and calculate real-time net worth and P&L
user_interactions: Navigate to Investments tab
View total portfolio value, invested amount, and total returns
Click Add Investment button to manually add stock, mutual fund, or asset
Search stock ticker or AMFI mutual fund scheme
Click Sync Live Prices to refresh market prices from Convex backend
Click Import Portfolio to upload CAMS/KFintech CAS statement or Excel sheet
View allocation breakdowns and individual holdings

features.name: Analytics and Visualizations
features.description: Visual charts of monthly spending, category distribution, and net worth growth
user_interactions: Navigate to Analytics tab
Select date range and filter by category
Hover over interactive Recharts bars and pie charts
View savings rate and monthly burn rate metrics
